function: Unsupervised network partitions RIS elements among NOMA users; actor-critic DRL places the UAV-mounted RIS in 3D; phases follow closed-form CSI alignment (p. 5, p. 7, p. 8).
system: Uplink grant-free NOMA; single-antenna BS and 2-6 UEs (scalar model); UAV-mounted passive reflecting RIS, N=200-800, continuous or 1-3-bit phases; 2 GHz (p. 4, p. 10, p. 13).
method: Unsupervised MLP (two hidden ReLU layers, softmax) with task loss for RIS partitioning; on-policy actor-critic DRL (two 128-unit layers, Gaussian policy) for UAV placement (p. 7, p. 9).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Nakagami-m (m=5) small-scale fading, probabilistic-LoS S-curve air-to-ground path loss, Gaussian channel-estimation error; users uniform in 100 m disk; self-generated samples, no measurements (p. 4, p. 10).
test_conditions: USL data vary user count '(3)-(6)', N 200-800, Pt 1-30 dBm; results swept over N, Pt, K=2-3; no unseen-condition test stated (p. 7, p. 11-12).
baselines: Non-learned: equal partitioning, fixed UAV position, simulated annealing, genetic algorithm, closed-form MST/MMF optimum; learned: only own ablations such as USL with fixed deployment (p. 9).
metrics: Sum rate, minimum rate, Jain fairness index, gap to closed-form optimum, gain over fixed deployment, DRL runtime versus SA and GA (p. 11, p. 13, p. 14).
complexity: Measured DRL placement runtime: 0.016 s versus 0.773 s for simulated annealing (p. 14); 0.013 s versus 0.511 s for GA (p. 15); no FLOPs or parameter counts.
q2_support: p. 7: "the dataset includes variations in user count (3)-(6), RIS size (N = 200 to 800), and transmit power (Pt = 1-30 dBm)"
q3_support: p. 9: "isolate the contribution of each design component"
q4_support: p. 14: "produces its placement in a single forward pass of the policy network in 0.016 s"
q5_support: p. 7: "dataset is generated by simulating wireless scenarios with users randomly placed within a disk"
notes: Included. The learned physical-layer decision is the USL partition of the RIS elements among users (predicted for PFR, and as a learned counterpart of the closed form for MST and MMF, p. 7 and p. 10). The DRL only places the UAV-mounted RIS, which is above the physical layer, but it is learned jointly with the partition, so step 1.4 passes. RIS phases are not learned (closed-form alignment, p. 5).
